cheats.name: Start locally without retired server checks
cheats.description: Starts a local game without the retired LGT handset-state, consent, and server-save checks. Online server saves remain unavailable.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: return an available handset state instead of rejecting airplane-mode, DS-lock, or roaming status
continue from first-run setup without opening the retired MIDAS privacy-consent request
select the game's existing no-server-save result for the initial title-screen check
run the existing result handler locally instead of starting the retired server-save request
